the recommendation prescribes a global XLA flag (--xla_gpu_deterministic_ops=true), which the brief excludes as the remedy, and docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-booking-determinism.html:15 records that the unset arm already passes byte identity and identical reads under the shared cache, so the +1.17% cost is recommended without evidence that the flag is necessary.

the qualifying-settings predicate accepts every setting (unset, deterministic, autotune-disabled) because it only compares each arm with itself, so it cannot distinguish a deterministic environment from a stable one and its name overstates what it establishes.
